name: Jinrou
source:
A monster who repeatedly commits disorderly murders in Amidahara.
He is rumored to be a werewolf monster from the demon world or a demon from another world.
The organizations that control Amidahara are in pursuit of him, but his true identity is completely unknown.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=680360]Getchu[/url]]
